title: General intelligence domains
description: Top-level domains that preserve the original contextual meaning of public information.
governanceNotes: FOOD_SECURITY_AND_NUTRITION represents a humanitarian, societal or national condition. AGRICULTURE_DOMAIN.FOOD_SECURITY separately represents agriculture and food-system relevance; both may be assigned when both meanings are supported.

terms.label: Politics and governance
terms.definition: Political institutions, public administration, elections, diplomacy and the exercise of public authority.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include political and governmental context; exclude purely commercial management and sector-specific technical administration.

terms.label: Conflict and security
terms.definition: Armed conflict, defense, terrorism, public security and material threats to safety or stability.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include hostile action and security conditions; exclude ordinary political disagreement without a security dimension.

terms.label: Humanitarian
terms.definition: Human welfare emergencies, displacement, relief operations and urgent protection or assistance needs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include crisis-driven human needs and response; exclude routine social services without an emergency or vulnerability context.

terms.label: Food security and nutrition
terms.definition: The humanitarian, societal or national condition in which people have reliable access to sufficient, safe and nutritious food and adequate nutrition.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include population-level food access, hunger, malnutrition and national food-security conditions; use AGRICULTURE_DOMAIN.FOOD_SECURITY additionally when agriculture or the food system is materially relevant.

terms.label: Economy
terms.definition: Macroeconomic conditions, growth, inflation, employment, finance and broad economic performance.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include economy-wide indicators and shocks; exclude price or performance changes limited to one market unless they have broader economic significance.

terms.label: Trade
terms.definition: Cross-border and domestic exchange, trade policy, tariffs, sanctions and commercial flows.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include movement and regulation of traded goods or services; exclude physical logistics when no commercial exchange issue is present.

terms.label: Energy
terms.definition: Energy production, supply, prices, infrastructure, fuels and power systems.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include energy-system conditions and policy; exclude general climate matters without a direct energy component.

terms.label: Health
terms.definition: Human health, disease, health systems, medicine and public-health conditions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include human health and health-service context; classify animal and plant health under agricultural domains unless human health is also affected.

terms.label: Weather and climate
terms.definition: Weather conditions, forecasts, climate patterns and climate-related hazards or change.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include atmospheric and climate context; exclude downstream agricultural or infrastructure effects unless separately classified.

terms.label: Environment
terms.definition: Ecosystems, biodiversity, pollution, natural resources and environmental conservation or degradation.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include environmental condition and stewardship; exclude weather alone and production impacts without an environmental dimension.

terms.label: Infrastructure and logistics
terms.definition: Transport, ports, roads, utilities, storage and systems that move people, goods or essential services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include physical networks and movement capacity; exclude commercial trade policy and energy generation unless separately relevant.

terms.label: Public events and sport
terms.definition: Organized public gatherings, cultural events, competitions and sporting activity.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include events whose primary meaning is public participation, culture or sport; exclude protests, disasters and political proceedings.

terms.label: Science and technology
terms.definition: Scientific research, technical development, innovation and adoption of technology.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include research and technology as the primary context; use a technology category additionally for specific technology families.

terms.label: Society
terms.definition: Demography, communities, culture, education, social conditions and collective behavior.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include broad social context; exclude acute humanitarian need and formal political activity when those are primary.

terms.label: Law and regulation
terms.definition: Legislation, judicial action, regulatory standards, enforcement and legal obligations.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include binding or formally proposed legal rules; exclude nonbinding policy announcements unless a legal mechanism is central.
